title: Use of Platelet Rich Plasma (PRP) for Improving Thin Endometrium
brief_summary: Platelets rich plasma is simple source of growth factors and cytokines that can regulate endometrial growth for subgroup of thin endometrium women. It is an autologous source of this enhancing factors; therefore, there os no risk of using it within the same participant.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* women with thin endometrium

Exclusion Criteria:

* serum positive hepatitis B and C women
